title: Voice Mode
description: Use OpenAI's Advanced Voice Mode to control Claude Code with your voice. Speak naturally to give commands, and receive spoken responses.
api_required: Required for Voice Mode. Get one from platform.openai.com.
show_button_desc: Display the microphone button in the AI input area
mic_denied: Voice Mode needs microphone access. Enable it for Nimbalyst in System Settings, then re-check below.
mic_restricted: Microphone access is restricted on this device (e.g. by parental controls or MDM). Voice Mode cannot capture audio.
mic_needs_access: Voice Mode needs microphone access. Open System Settings to grant it for Nimbalyst.
realtime_desc: gpt-realtime-2 is newer, with stronger reasoning, a larger context window, and more consistent voice rendering. gpt-realtime is the fallback for accounts without access (selected automatically if needed).
reasoning_desc: Higher = smarter but slower and more expensive. Low is recommended for a responsive voice relay. Applies to gpt-realtime-2.
voice_desc: Choose the voice for the assistant. Each voice has its own personality and tone.
preview_hint: Preview plays a short sample using OpenAI's TTS API.
realtime_only_hint: This voice is Realtime-only; preview uses a similar voice.
turn_detection_desc: Control how the assistant detects when you're speaking and when you're done.
input_mode_desc: Choose how voice input is captured
sensitivity_desc: How sensitive the microphone is to your voice. Lower = more sensitive (picks up quiet speech), Higher = less sensitive (requires louder speech).
pause_desc: How long to wait after you stop speaking before processing your request. Shorter = faster response, Longer = more time for natural pauses.
interruptions_desc: You can interrupt the assistant while it's speaking by starting to talk
listen_window_desc: How long to keep listening after you stop speaking. After this time, the mic goes to sleep until the assistant responds or you click the mic button.
review_delay_desc: Time to review and edit voice commands before they're sent to the coding agent. Set to 0 for immediate submission.
project_summary_hint: The voice assistant uses an AI-generated summary of your project to understand context. Stored in the project summary file.
configure_agent: Configure an agent to enable regeneration
summary_launch: Launches an agent session that reads your project and writes the summary file. You'll be taken to the session so you can watch it work.
configure_agent_settings: Configure one in AI Models settings
usage_desc: OpenAI charges for voice mode usage:
token_costs: Plus standard token costs for processing
how_desc_1: Voice Mode uses OpenAI's Advanced Voice Mode (GPT Realtime) as an intelligent voice interface to Claude Code. You speak your coding requests naturally, and the voice assistant translates them into Claude Code commands.
how_desc_2: When Claude Code finishes working, the assistant summarizes what was done and speaks it back to you.
prompt_customization_desc: Customize the behavior of the voice agent and coding agent during voice mode sessions.
voice_agent_desc: Customize the voice assistant (GPT-4 Realtime) that handles speech interaction.
coding_agent_desc: Customize the coding agent (Claude) when processing voice mode requests. These instructions are added to the system prompt only during voice mode sessions.
prepend_desc_voice: Added before the default voice assistant instructions
append_desc_voice: Added after the default voice assistant instructions
prepend_desc_coding: Added before the coding agent's voice mode context
append_desc_coding: Added after the coding agent's voice mode context
placeholder_formal: e.g., Always respond in a formal tone...
placeholder_files: e.g., When discussing code, always mention file names...
placeholder_brief: e.g., When responding to voice requests, prioritize brevity...
placeholder_summary: e.g., Always summarize what you did in 1-2 sentences at the end...
generate_summary_message: This will launch a new AI session using {{model}}. The session will read your project files and write a voice-friendly summary to {{path}}, which voice mode uses for context. You'll be taken to the session so you can watch it run.

errors.connection_failed: Failed to connect to voice service.
